headline: A 2005 executive order directing federal agencies to improve how they release information to the public.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to improve how they share information with the public. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, deadlines, and rules it sets cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to change or improve how they disclose information.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the public who request information from federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by changes in how agencies release information, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 14, 2005; the source does not state a separate effective date.
